programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people’s southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Forged in Legend: A Glimpse of Longquan Blades
programme.desc: Longquan swords, legendary blades from China, embody centuries of masterful craftsmanship. Forged with unique folding techniques and a distinctive star-patterned finish, these swords are renowned for their sharpness, resilience, and artistic value. Discover the rich history and cultural significance of these revered symbols of Chinese heritage.

programme.title: Shunde’s Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong—a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter—that’s the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals...

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing
programme.desc: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing delves into the historical origins and cultural background of Fengdu Ghost City, and also features the Zhongyuan Festival celebrations and ancestor-worshipping rituals held here. These activities reflect the local people’s positive and optimistic outlook on life and death, as well as the great importance they attach to their ancestors, families and family traditions.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.2
programme.desc: Heilongjiang, China's northernmost province, is home to a veritable sea of trees, a forest forged by the Greater and Lesser Khingan Ranges. Beginning our Odyssey at its very northern extremity - a land of snowy Arctic snowscape and dazzling rime-frosts that's a paradise for winter-sports daredevils - we then head for Harbin and its spectacular ice festival in pursuit of some unique snowy adventures...

programme.title: Shunde’s Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong—a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter—that’s the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals...

programme.title: Escape to Yibin
programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as "The First City along the Yangtze River", home to renowned Yibin Ranmian noodles and Wuliangye liquor. We explored plenty of lesser-known scenic spots: Lizhuang, the cultural hub during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; vast bamboo groves that embody the hermit culture of China; and the mysterious cliff-hanging coffins. It is precisely these secluded and strategically advantageous lands that enabled local cultures to be well preserved amid turbulent times.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people’s southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Forged in Legend: A Glimpse of Longquan Blades
programme.desc: Longquan swords, legendary blades from China, embody centuries of masterful craftsmanship. Forged with unique folding techniques and a distinctive star-patterned finish, these swords are renowned for their sharpness, resilience, and artistic value. Discover the rich history and cultural significance of these revered symbols of Chinese heritage.

programme.title: Shunde’s Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong—a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter—that’s the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals...

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing
programme.desc: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing delves into the historical origins and cultural background of Fengdu Ghost City, and also features the Zhongyuan Festival celebrations and ancestor-worshipping rituals held here. These activities reflect the local people’s positive and optimistic outlook on life and death, as well as the great importance they attach to their ancestors, families and family traditions.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.2
programme.desc: Heilongjiang, China's northernmost province, is home to a veritable sea of trees, a forest forged by the Greater and Lesser Khingan Ranges. Beginning our Odyssey at its very northern extremity - a land of snowy Arctic snowscape and dazzling rime-frosts that's a paradise for winter-sports daredevils - we then head for Harbin and its spectacular ice festival in pursuit of some unique snowy adventures...

programme.title: Shunde’s Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong—a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter—that’s the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals...

programme.title: Escape to Yibin
programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as "The First City along the Yangtze River", home to renowned Yibin Ranmian noodles and Wuliangye liquor. We explored plenty of lesser-known scenic spots: Lizhuang, the cultural hub during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; vast bamboo groves that embody the hermit culture of China; and the mysterious cliff-hanging coffins. It is precisely these secluded and strategically advantageous lands that enabled local cultures to be well preserved amid turbulent times.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Shunde's flavors: where tradition blends with vivid daily life
programme.desc: Shunde, a gastronomic gem in the Pearl River Delta, neighboring Hong Kong, uses masterful craft and sincere heart to transform local treasures – from crispy fish skin to fried milk – into culinary wonders. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia, are setting out to taste the flavors and feel the warmth of Shunde's countryside with the locals.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, traveling to the cities of Zhuzhou and Xiangtan to meet another group of extraordinary women. By capturing snippets of the lives and work of an electric locomotive designer, a flight instructor, a painter, and a poverty alleviation volunteer, we showcase the unique cultural and humanistic charm of this region.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: China's Ancient “Wall Street”: Pingyao
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Pingyao – the ancient "Wall Street" of China and a historic banking hub. Enclosed by ancient city walls and seemingly frozen in time, this entire city, together with two nearby ancient temples, offers a one-of-a-kind adventure at this UNESCO World Heritage Site!

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.3
programme.desc: Hainan- the anchor-point of China's southern frontier, its islands custodians of the vast South China Sea! And perhaps nothing embodies the allure of the oceanic wonderland more than the limpid waters of Sansha. From volcanic northern shores to cutting-edge modern cities, join us on coastal journey dotted with historic lighthouses illuminating a fascinating past and guiding the way to a promising future...

programme.title: Shunde's flavors: where tradition blends with vivid daily life
programme.desc: Shunde, a gastronomic gem in the Pearl River Delta, neighboring Hong Kong, uses masterful craft and sincere heart to transform local treasures – from crispy fish skin to fried milk – into culinary wonders. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia, are setting out to taste the flavors and feel the warmth of Shunde's countryside with the locals.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Capa Caída
programme.desc: Un documental sigue a Magno, superhéroe caído tras un escándalo, 20 años después.

programme.title: El Verano que te vimos
programme.desc: Un grupo de amigos se reencuentra para festejar año nuevo.

programme.title: Super Agente Botones
programme.desc: El super agente Jaime Bond es revivido en el cuerpo de un botones de hotel.

programme.title: El triunfo
programme.desc: Barcelona, decada de 1980: en un duro barrio urbano habitado por sobrevivientes y gobernado por exlegionarios -Gandhi, Fontan y Andrade-, quienes luchan una guerra por el control de las calles, Nen y sus amigos Palito, Topo y Tostao sueñan con triunfar en el mundo de la rumba.

Un taxista llamado Leo en Rosario está luchando con su relación y largas horas de trabajo. Un evento inesperado lo obliga a cambiar su rutina, y la ciudad cambiante y situaciones tensas lo llevan al limite.

programme.title: Tren de Bala Abatido
programme.desc: En su viaje inaugural, el tren de alta velocidad más rápido del mundo está equipado con una bomba que explotará si desciende por debajo de las 200 mph.

programme.title: La Fuga
programme.desc: Tras hacerse con el control de una prisión de máxima seguridad, un cerebro criminal se enfrenta a un agente retirado de Black Ops que había estado visitando a su hijo encarcelado.

programme.title: Scarecrow
programme.desc: Seis estudiantes de secundaria se enfrentan a una entidad maligna mientras cumplen su castigo antes del festival del espantapájaros del pueblo.

programme.title: Tormenta nuclear
programme.desc: Las alarmas se disparan en una central nuclear, que para colmo, se ve afectada por una tormenta de gran intensidad. Los encargados deberán hacer frente a esta situación para evitar una catástrofe.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Diez pasajeros de autobús quedan atrapados en un depósito de chatarra tras ser sacados de la carretera por unos motoristas. Para sobrevivir deben improvisar armas y tener las agallas suficientes para defenderse de los asesinos motoristas.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mientras un hombre conduce su moto por el desierto, unos matones le roban el vehículo y lo dan por muerto. Sobrevive y ya no piensa en el suicidio, porque ahora tiene un objetivo en la vida: vengarse y recuperar su moto.

programme.title: Vacaciones en el Infierno
programme.desc: Detenido y encarcelado en una prisión mexicana por tráfico de drogas, un hombre aprende a sobrevivir en este entorno hostil con la ayuda de un niño de 9 años.

programme.title: Ataque en el Aire
programme.desc: Unos agentes rusos secuestran un avión comercial estadounidense y planean estrellarlo contra una central nuclear cerca de Washington D.C., lo que provocará una lluvia radiactiva que devastará la costa este. Con poco tiempo para que los cazas de la Fuerza Aérea lo derriben, los pasajeros y la tripulación del avión deben confiar en su propia formación militar y civil para detener a los terroristas antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Planet Dune V2
programme.desc: Una tripulación en misión para salvar una base abandonada en un planeta desértico se convierte en mortal cuando son acechados y atacados por los principales depredadores del planeta: gusanos de arena gigantes.

programme.title: Asalto sin límite
programme.desc: Es una vida sucia y rentable de crimen para los ladrones de coches conocidos como «choppers». Se necesita velocidad, valor y saber hacer, pero si a eso le añadimos un asesinato y un policía encubierto, la cosa puede ponerse explosiva.

programme.title: Robot Apocalypse
programme.desc: Cuando la experta hacker Tara intenta detener a una poderosa inteligencia artificial que se apodera del ejército mundial, la inteligencia artificial la considera una terrorista que debe ser exterminada.

programme.title: Yatterman
programme.desc: La hermosa y ultra sexy Doronjo y sus malvados esbirros, sedientos de dinero, fama y poder, intentan recuperar los pedazos de una legendaria piedra con poderes misteriosos. Pero sus planes se verán interrumpidos por Gan, Ai y su fiel perro robot gigante, quienes iniciarán una frenética carrera contrarreloj para impedir que la gema caiga en manos de los villanos.

programme.title: El valle Oscuro
programme.desc: Un jinete solitario llega a un remoto y aislado pueblo de los Alpes austríacos, donde, a pesar de no ser bienvenido, se le permite quedarse antes del duro invierno. Se presenta como un fotógrafo de Estados Unidos, pero nadie sospecha que el misterioso extranjero ha llegado al valle para cumplir una venganza. La violencia flota en el aire en este pueblo de leñadores, dominado por un viejo clan familiar que impone sus leyes, aterrorizando a sus habitantes.

programme.title: Tarzán en Manhattan
programme.desc: Tarzán viaja a Nueva York para rescatar al chimpancé Chita, que ha sido capturado por un malvado experimentador con animales. Allí forma equipo con Jane, taxista e hija de un ex policía detective privado, que ayuda a Tarzán a liberar a Chita y a sus amigos.

programme.title: El Comando
programme.desc: Un agente de la DEA que sufre un trastorno de estrés postraumático debe proteger a su familia de un ataque a su casa después de que un delincuente convicto y sus secuaces vengan a buscar su alijo de millones dentro de la casa del agente.

programme.title: Rescue Team
programme.desc: Sur une ile Asiatique, une équipe de scientifiques étudie la récente apparition d’un virus mortel. Ce dernier prend la forme d’une maladie dégénérescente et les habitants locaux en sont les premières victimes. Après avoir découvert l’existence d’un « elixir de vie », les scientifiques vont disparaitre en laissant derrière eux un message d’alerte concernant cette terrible maladie qui se propage rapidement. Les forces armées internationales et des mercenaires prêts à tout, débarquent sur l’ile avec un enjeu majeur, la survie de l’humanité pour certains mais surtout de nombreux intérêts personnels.

programme.title: Dystopia
programme.desc: Nous sommes en 2037. Notre monde se meurt lentement d'un virus qui a rendu l'humanité stérile. Aucun enfant n'est né depuis 25 ans. Les gouvernements sont devenus les marionnettes impuissantes des plus grandes entreprises et Biocorp, la plus grande du monde, ne cesse de promettre un remède qui ne viendra jamais

programme.title: Dernières Heures de la Terre
programme.desc: Après que de la matière dense provenant d’un trou blanc implosé ait frappé la Terre, la rotation de la planète est dévastée. Un groupe d’agents gouvernementaux doit retrouver un réseau de satellites perdu, seul espoir de survie pour l’humanité.

programme.title: Triple Action
programme.desc: Une mercenaire sexy et mortelle s'attaque à un syndicat international de trafiquants d'armes dirigé par la mafia russe.

programme.title: Desert Strike
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire au passé mystérieux conduit un groupe de réfugiés égyptiens à travers le désert et doit les protéger d'un groupe de mercenaires diaboliques.

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l’établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l’aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l’alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l’empire criminel d’Ik-ho.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond est un blanchisseur d'argent à New York qui se réveille sans aucun souvenir, avec des millions de dollars en espèces volées et de la drogue. Il doit rapidement parcourir les rues à la recherche de réponses tout en essayant d'échapper à une équipe de policiers violents et corrompus.

programme.title: Le Jour de La Colère
programme.desc: Espagne, au XVIe siècle pendant l'Inquisition. Une série de meurtres particuliers secoue le pays. Le shérif Ruy de Mendoza mène l'enquête...

programme.title: Swim
programme.desc: Une famille est prise au piège alors que la maison de vacances qu'elle loue est inondée par la pluie et qu'un requin agressif a réussi à s'y introduire.

programme.title: Fatal Instinct
programme.desc: Un détective de police suit une piste d'indices qui semble finalement mener au frère ex-détenu de son partenaire de confiance, qu'il a aidé à mettre en prison il y a des années.

programme.title: American Ninja 5
programme.desc: Lorsque la fille d'un scientifique est kidnappée, American Ninja (David Bradley) tente de la retrouver, mais cette fois-ci, il fait équipe avec un jeune qu'il a formé aux techniques du ninja.

programme.title: Héritage
programme.desc: Lors d'un voyage de chasse dans la région sauvage isolée, un père et son fils adolescent adoptif sont transformés en proies d'agresseurs inconnus. Ils sont rejoints dans leur lutte pour la survie par un étranger qui révèle la troublante vérité sur le père biologique du fils, un seigneur du crime international, et pourquoi ce seigneur du crime a envoyé des assassins entraînés pour tuer l'adolescent.

programme.title: Flammes sur la ville
programme.desc: Scott Daniels, ingénieur de la ville de Millwood, venu de Houston, enquête sur une série d'incendies mystérieux. Jesse, le fils unique de Scott et Lourie Harper, qui a détesté le déménagement ou la maison de jeunesse de son père, simule une fièvre et invite sa nouvelle petite amie Carmen.

programme.title: Poursuite Mortelle
programme.desc: Un groupe de cinq alpinistes fait de la randonnée et de l'escalade dans les Highlands écossais lorsqu'il découvre une jeune fille serbe enterrée dans une petite chambre en pleine nature. Ils se retrouvent alors pris dans un terrifiant jeu du chat et de la souris avec les ravisseurs, alors qu'ils tentent de mettre la jeune fille à l'abri.

programme.title: Davide E Golia
programme.desc: Con Orson Welles, Davide affronta Golia nella sfida che segna il destino di Israele

programme.title: El calle de los conflictos
programme.desc: Un sheriff intenta detener los conflictos entre colonos en el Oeste tras la Guerra de Secesión.

programme.title: Il Terrore Dei Mari
programme.desc: Tra arrembaggi e inseguimenti nei mari tropicali, un audace pirata sfida flotte nemiche e tradimenti per conquistare libertà e tesori. Un’avventura ricca di azione e colpi di scena, firmata da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: 7 Winchester per un Massacro
programme.desc: Un pistolero se une a una banda de guerrilleros confederados para encontrar un alijo de oro confederado desaparecido.

programme.title: Zorro Contro Maciste
programme.desc: Tra duelli e imprese eroiche, Zorro e Maciste uniscono le forze contro un potere tirannico, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Jeb Drummond es un pastor de ovejas asesino que ha tomado a Adam como rehén para intentar obligar a Ben a cederle una gran parte de las tierras de Ponderosa.

programme.title: Barabba
programme.desc: Liberato al posto di Gesù, il brigante Barabba vive tormentato dal dubbio su chi fosse davvero l’uomo condannato alla croce.

programme.title: Ases y Ochos
programme.desc: Los pacíficos colonos de una ciudad destinada a la grandeza del ferrocarril se arriesgan a establecerse en el inexplorado Oeste y, de repente, son asesinados a tiros sin piedad. Sin ley ni orden, la justicia recae sobre los hombros de un anciano ranchero y un pistolero consumado pero retirado.

programme.title: Erode Il Grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP19 - Los asesinos a sueldo
programme.desc: Hoss y Little Joe son confundidos con sanguinarios asesinos a sueldo en un pequeño pueblo de Texas dominado por dos familias enemistadas.

programme.title: Corsicana
programme.desc: El ayudante del sheriff Bass Reeves se reencuentra con su antiguo compañero y fugitivo Sam Tanner. Junto con un antiguo francotirador de la Unión, se enfrentan a una carrera contrarreloj para seguir la pista de Jack Donner y su despiadada banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Maciste Contro I Cacciatori Di Teste
programme.desc: In terre selvagge e misteriose, Maciste sfida tribù feroci e pericoli mortali per salvare innocenti e ristabilire la pace.

programme.title: Sandokan Alla Riscossa
programme.desc: Tra mari esotici e scontri contro il potere coloniale, Sandokan torna a combattere per la libertà del suo popolo, tra arrembaggi e duelli.

programme.title: Honor entre ladrones
programme.desc: Después de ser herido en la guerra, un veterano de la guerra civil regresa a su hogar en Texas y descubre que ahora está alistado en una nueva batalla; uno por su vida.

programme.title: Sandokan Contro Il Leopardo Di Sarawak
programme.desc: Tra giungle e mari esotici, Sandokan sfida il temibile Leopardo di Sarawak in una lotta tra vendetta e libertà, tra duelli e battaglie spettacolari.

programme.title: Yellow Rock
programme.desc: Cinco hombres cabalgan hacia el inquietante pueblo de Yellow Rock, con la esperanza de rescatar a un familiar y a su hijo perdido.

programme.title: L'ira Di Achille
programme.desc: Sullo sfondo della guerra di Troia, Achille affronta battaglie e passioni travolgenti guidato dall’onore e dalla sete di vendetta.

programme.title: UN AMENAZA EN LA SOMBRA
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su madre, un cazarrecompensas de armas tomar encuentra al padre que nunca conoció, que está librando una guerra en la pradera contra un poderoso barón de la tierra.

programme.title: Érase una vez en Tombstone
programme.desc: Esta película ofrece todos los grandes personajes que cabría esperar en una película sobre Tombstone. Los hermanos Earp, los hermanos Clanton, Doc Holliday, Johnny Ringo, etc. y grandes tiroteos. Lo que la película ofrece es una multitud de piezas del rompecabezas que completan la historia, no sólo acerca de por qué ocurrió el tiroteo, sino la historia real de lo que condujo a ella y lo que siguió.

programme.title: Afrodite, Dea Dell'amore
programme.desc: Tra passioni proibite, intrighi di corte e sfide al potere, Afrodite intreccia destino e seduzione nel cuore del mito. Con Anthony Steffen e Isabelle Corey.

programme.title: Una historia de dos pistolas
programme.desc: En el anárquico Oeste, los Cowboys, una tristemente célebre hermandad de asesinos y ladrones, gobernaban con puños y pistolas. El destino finalmente los ha alcanzado, y ahora la despiadada banda solo tiene un miembro superviviente.

programme.title: La Spada E La Croce
programme.desc: Con Yvonne De Carlo, passioni e destino si intrecciano nella Roma attraversata da grandi cambiamenti.

programme.title: El Hombre de Utah
programme.desc: En un concurso de equitación, los malos quieren que John Weston pierda. Cuando éste se niega, añaden un seguro: una aguja envenenada justo debajo de su montura.

programme.title: Giuseppe Venduto Dai Fratelli
programme.desc: Tradito dai fratelli e venduto come schiavo, Giuseppe affronta prove durissime in Egitto fino a diventare uomo di fiducia del faraone.

programme.title: Lone Rider
programme.desc: Con un alentador drama familiar y una acción que sube la adrenalina, Lone Rider es un western con agallas, gloria y un poderoso mensaje. Bob Hattaway, un soldado honrado, regresa a su pueblo natal del Oeste para descubrir que el terrateniente corrupto Stu Croaker se ha convertido en el hombre más poderoso del condado.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Gladiatore
programme.desc: Diretto da Alfonso Brescia con Mark Forest, un gladiatore affronta tiranni e tradimenti in una Roma dominata dal potere.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP21 - La subvención española
programme.desc: Los Cartwright intentan refutar la validez de una concesión de tierras española para impedir que la familia De La Cuesta se apodere de parte de Ponderosa y de todas las tierras de los colonos de Carson Valley.

programme.title: Los Largos dias de la venganza
programme.desc: Después de tres años de trabajos forzados, Ted Barnett se fuga de la cárcel para vengarse de los tres hombres que le inculparon.

programme.title: La Vendetta Dei Gladiatori
programme.desc: Nell’antica Roma, un eroe affronta tradimenti e duelli mortali per vendicare il proprio popolo e sfidare il potere

programme.title: El angel vengador
programme.desc: Miles Utley es un comando/guardaespaldas mormón profesional que se ve obligado a convertirse en renegado y a cuestionar su fe cuando investiga un escándalo de asesinato y especulación de tierras.

programme.title: Sandokan Alla Riscossa
programme.desc: Tra mari esotici e scontri contro il potere coloniale, Sandokan torna a combattere per la libertà del suo popolo, tra arrembaggi e duelli.

programme.title: La Balada de Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Un gángster supuestamente muerto quiere implicar a un hombre completamente inocente para que pague por sus crímenes y así poder dar esquinazo a sus vengadores y perseguidores.

programme.title: La Rivolta Dei Mercenari
programme.desc: In un territorio sconvolto dalla ribellione, un gruppo di spietati mercenari viene ingaggiato per reprimere una rivolta, ma tradimenti e ambizioni personali accendono una lotta feroce per il potere.

programme.title: Les Pirates du Mississipi
programme.desc: Un groupe de pirates menés par Kelly, un bandit habillé tout en noir, sème la terreur en s'en prenant aux habitants de Helena et aux bateaux postiers sur le Mississippi. Le shérif James Lively doit aller contre la méfiance des habitants mais aussi des Indiens. Mais avec l'aide des Cherokees, car les bandits se sont établis sur leurs terres, et de son adjoint Tom Quincy, il parvient à mettre fin à leurs méfaits.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: Je vais... je tire... et je reviens
programme.desc: Un gang dérobe une cargaison d'or dans un train. Un soi-disant chasseur de primes est envoyé à la recherche des voleurs et décide de les laisser le conduire jusqu'à l'or.

programme.title: No Name & Dynamite
programme.desc: No Name and Dynamite commence lorsque nous rencontrons le partenariat de chasse aux primes entre No Name (Northup) et Dynamite Davenport (Ting), qui font leur propre chemin pour collecter les primes, mais s'entraident lorsqu'il s'agit des primes les plus difficiles.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Trois déserteurs se sont échappés d'une caserne de l'armée pour rejoindre le Ponderosa. Lorsqu'un capitaine vient les chercher, Ben comprend ce qu'ils ont dû endurer et promet de faire connaître la vérité à son bon ami responsable du fort.

programme.title: Ta tombe est prête Sartana !
programme.desc: Deux cow-boys se font voler leur or dans les montagnes rocheuses et décident de se défendre en affrontant les bandits.

programme.title: Macho Callaghan se déchaîne
programme.desc: Un tireur solitaire traque les membres d'un gang de hors-la-loi qui a tué ses amis.

programme.title: Billy va te plomber
programme.desc: Quatre hors-la-loi de l'Ouest effectuent un braquage de banque dans la ville de la ruée vers l'or, Bath Water. Alors que le groupe se lance à la poursuite, les choses empirent, car les bandits se rendent compte qu'ils ont été doublés.

programme.title: Killer Kid
programme.desc: L'impitoyable et cruel capitaine Ramirez traque et tue les révolutionnaires dans sa quête du Saint, le chef vertueux de l'insurrection mexicaine contre les Fédéraux.

programme.title: Planques toi minable, Trinita arrive...
programme.desc: Après plusieurs tentatives d'escroquerie infructueuses, l'escroc Jonathan Duke et son partenaire Sebastian Carter font équipe avec Ringo et sa bande pour dévaliser le général mexicain Eldorado.

programme.title: Buckaroo ne pardonne pas
programme.desc: Al arrive dans la ville dirigée par Lash qui a pris possession d'une mine d'or et cherche maintenant à récupérer l'autre, qui appartient au vieux Johnny. Al est le seul à soutenir Johnny mais le vieil homme est quand même pris en embuscade et tué.

programme.title: Et le vent apporta la violence
programme.desc: Un homme se venge de la famille responsable de sa condamnation injustifiée à dix ans de travaux forcés.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: On continue à l'appeller Trinita
programme.desc: Bambino essaie d'apprendre à son frère Trinity comment devenir un hors-la-loi, mais ils finissent par sauver une famille de pionniers et à défaire un réseau de contrebande.

programme.title: Le Géant de Métropolis
programme.desc: Muscleman Ohro se rend dans la capitale pécheresse de l'Atlantide pour réprimander son impiété et son orgueil, et s'engage dans la bataille contre son seigneur maléfique Yoh-tar et ses plans hideux de super-science.

programme.title: La Charge des Cosaques
programme.desc: L'histoire de Hadji Murad, un chef tchétchène du XIXe siècle qui a mené ses guerriers dans une lutte contre les forces d'invasion du tsar russe.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.desc: La misión de Jason Lozano Ministries es llevar el mensaje de libertad a las naciones. A través de ganar almas y hacer discípulos podemos ayudar a las naciones a hacer una vida de libertad.

programme.title: Impactando las Naciones
programme.desc: Impactando Naciones es un programa televisivo conducido por la Pastora Wanda Rolón, dedicado a compartir un mensaje transformador de fe, esperanza y poder espiritual y motivando a todo aquel que busca una experiencia real con Dios.

programme.title: Andrés Spyker de Más Vida
programme.desc: Conéctate cada semana con un mensaje fresco de la palabra de Dios con una aplicación práctica para tu vida.

programme.title: Dr. Robert Jeffries - Camino a la Victoria
programme.desc: Pastor de la Primera Iglesia Bautista de Dallas, Texas, y autor, el Dr. Robert Jeffress, ofrece a los espectadores y feligreses una colección de aplicaciones prácticas e inspiradoras derivadas de las Sagradas Escrituras para la sociedad actual.

programme.title: Andrew Wommack La Verdad Del Evangelio
programme.desc: Andrew Wommack comparte cómo la Palabra de Dios transformó su vida. Él cree que el mismo poder puede obrar para ti. Su enseñanza es profunda, clara y tan simple que hasta un niño puede entenderla.

programme.title: A Toda Luz
programme.desc: ¿Te hace falta ánimo o quieres crecer en tu fe junto a otros? A Toda Luz es un programa lleno de vida, con conversaciones reales, risas, y verdades que inspiran. Con voces dinámicas y temas relevantes, te anima, te conecta y te acerca más a Dios.

programme.title: El cielo en la Tierra
programme.desc: Predicación de la Iglesia Cristiana "El Lugar de su Presencia" en Bogotá, Colombia, Latinoamérica. Con temas relevantes y prácticos, aplicables a la vida diaria y consejos bíblicos para alentar, animar y reflexionar en toda situación.

programme.title: Sid Roth - ¡Es Sobrenatural!
programme.desc: Sid Roth, un judío creyente en Jesús, ha pasado más de 35 años investigando la cualidad sobrenatural de Dios. Él quiere guiarte para que tengas una relación íntima con Dios y camines en milagros.

programme.title: Joni Table Talk

programme.title: Journey of a Legendary Landscape Painting
programme.desc: This documentary provides an immersive look into the intangible cultural heritage techniques woven into Chinese dance drama. programme.title: Our Neighbors in the Wild Ep.2

programme.desc: Follow traveling host He Tianran as he explores Xizang's many cultural treasures. programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: It is easy to overlook the tiny in stature, but sometimes the smallest should be the most feared. On this episode of Killer Instinct, three big little assassins prove that size has nothing to do with survival.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Apex predators sit comfortably atop the food chain. Cunning as they are large, they rule over their environments. Large and in-charge, their speed and bulk deliver a knockout blow.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Venom, a lethal weapon brandished by hundreds of animals of all shapes and sizes, over land and sea. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll meet three creatures whose venomous sting strikes fear in the hearts of people around the globe.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Nature’s heavyweight battles test the most powerful animals’ killer instincts and their will to live. On this episode, we explore what happens when the world’s most deadly apex predators go head to head for survival!

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Few things in nature conjure such instant fear as a set of killer teeth rising out of gaping jaws. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll examine a number of sharp toothed animals worthy of a much closer look.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Great Lakes
programme.desc: Through several interlocking stories including the story of maritime commerce and the ships that move cargo through the inland waterway, Mysteries of the Great Lakes will take you on a journey through the greatest lake system in the world, and showcase the amazing geography, ecology, science, and history of the region.

programme.title: African Nostalgia
programme.desc: Africa seen and described through the eyes of a wildlife photographer who has always been fascinated by the unique atmosphere of this extraordinary continent.

programme.title: Quolls: Fast and Furious
programme.desc: A marsupial native cat has stalked the mountain tops of its northern domain for thousands of years. In the lush tropical rainforests of northern Queensland, the largest surviving marsupial carnivore on mainland Australia has remained isolated and hidden from sight… until now!

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel comes face-to-face with the Philippine cobra, the most lethally venomous cobra on the planet. And in deep, dark caves on Palawan Island, the presenter searches for giant reticulated pythons sheltering from the heat of the day.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Infra-red cameras in the dead of night reveals a forest pit-viper sense and strike a target just fractionally warmer than its surroundings. Then there's the mussurana - a snake that not only eats other snakes but is immune to their venom.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: In the tunnels of a leafcutter ant nest, we uncover a Central American coral snake sharing the burrow. Nigel meets a rattlesnake without a rattle, and a young Mexican cantil uses its white tail tip to attract prey close for a deadly strike.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Snakes are highly-adapted to survive in the scorching deserts of Arabia, and Nigel's skills are tested to find his top ten. Will the saw-scaled viper's venom and lightning reflexes be a match for the backwards strike of the puff adder?

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest: Shark Paradise of Polynesia
programme.desc: French Polynesia's great hammerhead sharks are extraordinarily shy animals and still pose many questions, not least where they go during their annual migration. Freediver Frederic Buyle and cameraman Christian Petron team up with scientist Dr. Johan Mourir to investigate these bizarre predators.

programme.title: Giant Sea Serpent: Meet the Myth
programme.desc: Its 10-meter length and silver ribbon shape inspired the myth of the sea serpent. Off the French Riviera, buoys set 2,000 meters deep attract pelagic species, including the Giant Oarfish—“King of Herrings”—drifting vertically, alone or in pairs. With expert guidance and passionate collaborators, a scientific expedition unveils the biology of this mysterious ambassador of the abyss.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: It’s no secret that birds were the inspiration for the first airplanes but, in this episode, host Danni Washington takes a look at how exactly that connection succeeded. She’ll fly planes in tight formation to try to mimic the energy-efficient flight patterns of migrating birds, look at how engineers are inventing wings that change their shape while in flight… and even jump out of a perfectly good plane to test out an innovation based on the flying squirrel!

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: Lately, we’ve been turning toward nature more and more while creating our buildings, not just for the materials, but in the way they’re constructed! In this episode, join host, Danni Washington, as she tours the "living building" known as the Bullit Center. This six-story structure mimics a tree; creating its own energy, collecting its own water, and even recycling its own waste. And come along for the ride as we check out other nature-based innovations that are changing our buildings, like a paint that protects them by mimicking the water-resistant properties of the lotus leaf and a waste-movement system based on the intestines of amazing creatures such as the giant blue whale!

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: Every species found in nature is a survivor, there’s a reason they’ve been on the planet for as long as they have. So host Danni Washington is trying to figure out what humankind can learn from them that we can use to protect ourselves. She’ll explore how fish are helping us to build better armor, how woodpeckers are assisting us to address a top safety concern in the form of concussions, and how one of the deadliest creatures found in nature is now saving lives by keeping planes in the sky during icy conditions!

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: The ocean covers more than 70 percent of our planet’s surface and humankind has only explored about 5% of it. But the diverse wildlife from the areas we have investigated serves as a major source of inspiration for modern technology! Host Danni Washington uses this episode as an opportunity to continue the investigation, heading under the sea to explore a reef that’s full of life, checking out an invention based on lobster eyes, and becoming one with the fish by turning her feet into fins before riding inside a vehicle based on sharks, whales, and dolphins that will launch her in to, out of, and under the water!

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: It is undisputable that despite their supposedly primitive technology, the societies that flourished almost 2000 years before Christ were able to accomplish unbelievable feats that forever changed the understanding of the world for all humankind.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: It was the Dark Ages… and from the cold North Sea a pagan maritime civilization exploded… and brutally raided and terrorized Europe… they were the Vikings.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: China is one of the world’s oldest civilizations and has one of the most well-­‐documented historical accounts in existence. Rich with records of early dynasties, warfare, ancient traditions and architecture, China is home to some of the most amazing archaeological sites in the world.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Lost civilizations, shipwrecks, sea creatures and sunken treasure…our oceans cover seventy-one percent of the Earth’s surface and yet, more than ninety-five percent is yet to be explored. This final frontier offers a hidden world of secrets to uncover.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Alexander the Great…Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt…Vlad III Dracul, Prince of Romania…the legacy of these historical icons live on in our modern day culture, but the mysterious circumstances that surround their deaths and conflicting reports of their final resting places have inspired worldwide investigation and unleashed a furious hunt to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Kanga Pan: An African Horror Story
programme.desc: Kanga Pan – An African Horror Story is a spine-chilling, one-off wildlife documentary, the first of its kind. A relatively unknown inland waterhole in Mana Pools National Park, Kanga Pan is a gathering point for a melting pot of wildlife species. On the surface, it looks like a peaceful oasis, offering the cooling refreshment of water and bathing.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: The lions are on the hunt for giraffe. Meanwhile, researcher Rae accompanies the lions as they encounter nervy hartebeest. The game capture unit are tasked with supplying more zebra for the Ngama release site. And don’t miss the action as hungry Kwali zones in on an unsuspecting zebra. But can she hold on?

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: Phyre has to be darted to keep the balance in the pride healthy, while Pazza shows off her highly possessive nature with an unsuspecting tortoise. And Milo demonstrates why he wears the pants around here.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: We follow the as they walk and stalk. Meat preparation gets weird for some as our volunteers make dinner time more interesting. A brave zebra stallion takes the fight to the ever confident lions. A historical moment is notched up for Wakanaka as she proves her predatory prowess.

programme.title: Volcanoes of the Deep Sea
programme.desc: Plunge into the ocean 12,000 feet deep for an unprecedented experience of this vast and little-explored dimension of our planet. The film follows a team of scientists as they dive to research mysterious hydrothermal vents on the mid-ocean ridge.

programme.title: Space Junk
programme.desc: After 50 years of launching our dreams into space, we're left with a troubling legacy: a growing ring of orbiting debris that casts a shadow over the future of space exploration. Space Junk 3D is a visually explosive, sensory expanding voyage into our now-threatened Final Frontier. Experience mind-boggling collisions, both natural and manmade. Soar from the stunning depths of Meteor Crater to an unprecedented view of our increasingly crowded orbits -- 22,000 miles above Earth. Join us as the foremost expert, also known as the "Father of Space Junk," guides us through the challenges we face in protecting them, forging a new age of space discovery.

programme.title: Wonders of the Arctic
programme.desc: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. Ice is to the Arctic as trees are to the rainforest.

programme.title: Serengeti: Journey to the Heart of Africa
programme.desc: Life happened in the Serengeti on an unprecedented scale. It's home to most of Africa's most iconic animals, and hosts one of the world's greatest natural events — the annual wildebeest migration. Nature has orchestrated a perfect symphony in which every species has a very distinct role to play in a larger story -- the balance of an entire ecosystem. We'll see it through the eyes of the youngest members of our animal cast as they imitate their parents, and learn about the mighty roles they'll play. Prepare to be awed by this immersive Giant Screen film about how nature works in one of the world's greatest ecosystems.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: You don’t have to be a heavyweight in the animal kingdom to possess killer instincts, but it sure does help. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll meet three scale-tipping heavyweights.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Killer instincts plus intelligence ensures survival in the most imaginative ways. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll get to see how the cute dolphin is actually a highly cunning pack hunter who uses all the tools around it to successfully devour prey.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Battles for survival play out every day in the animal kingdom. For the majority of animals, each battle is an uncertainty. But for a fortunate few, the odds are tilted much more in their favor.

programme.title: Le Vétérans
programme.desc: Trente ans après la chute de Saigon, le politicien Ray Watson retourne au Vietnam pour apaiser ses démons, mais il est confronté à un prisonnier de guerre qu'il a laissé derrière lui et qui le force à revivre le jour de leur capture.

programme.title: Une mariée en cavale
programme.desc: Juste avant son mariage, Lisa plaque son fiancé infidèle, Max, et prend le bus direction l'aéroport pour quitter l'Afrique. Le destin veut que son ancien amoureux, Vic, venu ici elle cinq ans plus tôt, voyage dans ce même bus. Il convoie incognito le Nuage d'Anamanga, un diamant légendaire. Mais le car est attaqué et la pierre tant convoitée est dérobée. Menottés l'un à l'autre, Lisa et Vic prennent la fuite dans la jungle...

programme.title: Ma Fille Kidnappée!
programme.desc: Après que Teri, une voisine, ait proposé de "garder" sa fille et que celle-ci ait disparu, Susan, une mère, devra revenir sur la mort de son mari pour la sauver.

programme.title: La Disparue
programme.desc: Le corps de Yoon Seol Hee disparaît à l'Institut National d'Investigation Scientifique. Le détective Woo Joong Shik cherche des indices sur sa disparition, tandis que son mari Park Jin Han affirme qu'elle est en vie.

programme.title: Miss Julie
programme.desc: Au XIXème siècle, un grand propriétaire terrien s'en va fêter la Saint-Jean, laissant seule au domaine la comtesse Julie, sa fille. Celle-ci, vivant mal la rupture récente de ses fiançailles, est dans une phase douloureuse de son existence. Désemparée, elle se saoule et rejoint les domestiques. L'un d'eux, Jean, la convoite depuis de longues années. Il voit en elle un moyen de monter dans l’échelle sociale et n’hésite pas à tirer parti de la situation.

programme.title: Présomption d'innocence
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: Deadly Ruphoria
programme.desc: Une rare soirée entre amies tourne au cauchemar pour Shana Jones, étudiante à l’université, lorsque Romeon Kingston, chef d’un réseau de traite des êtres humains, jette son dévolu sur elle.

programme.title: Suspicion
programme.desc: Catherine rencontre Nick, un veuf, qu'elle épouse et avec qui elle emménage. Des choses étranges commencent à lui arriver dans son appartement. Est-elle en train de l'imaginer ou...

programme.title: Amour, Romance & Chocolat
programme.desc: Emma et le chocolatier Luc concourent pour le titre de chocolatier royal de Belgique. La beauté et le romantisme de Bruges inspirent des combinaisons de chocolat uniques, mais leur projet gagnera-t-il sans qu'ils ne perdent leur cœur ?

programme.title: I love my mum
programme.desc: Un duo mère-fils est expédié par inadvertance dans un conteneur de Londres au Maroc avec rien d'autre que leur pyjama. L'aventure les emmène à travers l'Espagne et la France pour rentrer chez eux et reconstruire leur relation rocailleuse.

programme.title: The Other Me
programme.desc: Un architecte est atteint d'une maladie oculaire qui l'introduit dans une réalité surréaliste dans laquelle il voit les motivations des gens. Les visions devenant intolérables, il tombe amoureux d'une femme mystérieuse.

programme.title: Pour de mauvaises raisons
programme.desc: An ensemble film about four everyday people: a store manager, a security guard, a fire fighter and a clerk who struggle in the aftermath of trauma.

programme.title: Présumés coupables: souvenirs volés
programme.desc: Anna (Alexandra Neldel) reçoit un appel téléphonique de son nouveau partenaire commercial Philipp Rothkamm (Maximilian von Pufendorf) : Dans une université d'élite, une jeune femme (Emily Cox) affirme avoir été abusée sexuellement sous l'influence de gouttes de knock-out à une fête de la fraîcheur. Mais après un entretien personnel, ses doutes surgissent. Peu de temps après, la jeune femme se suicide.

programme.title: Piège en haute couture
programme.desc: Sophie (Jeri Ryan), créatrice de mode respectueuse de l'environnement et défenseur des femmes dans le monde entier, est sur le point de lancer sa ligne de vêtements très attendue et d'ouvrir son premier magasin phare lorsqu'une de ses employées est retrouvée assassinée.

programme.title: Amour et préméditation
programme.desc: Une ancienne avocate de la défense, qui travaille maintenant comme avocate spécialisée dans les divorces, est invitée à représenter le mari de sa meilleure amie, qui a été accusé de son meurtre.
